stem: In a certain country, $20\,540$ adults out of a population of $6\,012\,300$ have a degree in medicine.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Use an approximating distribution to calculate the probability that, in a random sample of 1000 adults in this country, there will be fewer than 4 adults who have a degree in medicine.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Justify the approximating distribution used in part **(a)**.
